name: @algomaker/supervisor
description: The recenter supervisor: leases each book, turns feed ticks into engine inputs, and routes the engine's decisions at desk-api. Replaces the Python desk supervisor.
_comment:dependencies: EVERY workspace package this app imports is declared here, including the ones that already resolve. npm hoists the workspace symlinks into the root node_modules, so an undeclared @algomaker/* import resolves anyway — right up until the day the package is not installed at the root, or this app is built on its own, and then it is a MODULE_NOT_FOUND in the process that steers live books. @algomaker/bus and @algomaker/instruments were the two missing (found by the same audit that caught them in order-gateway); both are imported by src/, not only by tests.
